$comment: The files the dev-only admin page (#/admin, scripts/admin-server.ts) may read and write: nothing else. policy: "edit" (default), "append-only" (new keys only, existing values locked), "read-only". A schema (JSON Schema, checked by Ajv here and by npm run data:validate) drives the editor; without one the editor follows the data's own shape and the server keeps every value's type.

sections.title: Effect cards (draft, not in the game)

files.title: Casino
files.note: The slot machine, pachinko and capsule machine (the roulette is in Coins, caps & missions).

files.title: Boss difficulties
files.note: Boss coin rewards are in Coins, caps & missions; this file is the fights' timers, hearts and score multipliers (also checked by npm run data:validate).

files.title: Cosmic anomalies
files.note: Chances and texts are live. A new anomaly also needs its id added to AnomalyId (src/gacha/anomalies.ts) and its class in src/index.css.

files.title: Card artwork
files.note: Cards keep the picture they were pulled with: existing pictures are locked. You can add a picture for a name (or a franchise) that has none yet.

files.title: Frozen card rarities
files.note: A released card's rarity never changes (npm run cards:freeze adds new cards). Shown for reference only.

files.title: Effect cards (proposal)
files.note: Proposed data shape for buff / debuff / modifier cards (src/gacha/effects.ts). Not played yet: "enabled" stays false until the owner approves the design and the hooks are wired into the games.
